B18m (1987) https://www.mat.univie.ac.at/~slc/opapers/s18kurth.html (generalising Book 1983 and F. Otto, C. Wrathall, Math. Systems Theory 18 (1985) 135-143, https://doi.org/10.1007/BF01699465; see also C. Wrathall, LNCS 572 (1992) 237-246), combined with L. J. Guibas, A. M. Odlyzko, JCTA 30 (1981) 183-208. history.old: Combination of Newman's lemma, the critical-pair lemma and Guibas-Odlyzko (1981); analogue of a one-element Groebner basis (Bergman 1978). Probably folklore; pending Historian audit.

statement:
Let u != v be words of length k over a q-letter alphabet with Borders(u) contained in Borders(v). Then
{u -> v} is convergent, the classes of length-n words modulo u = v correspond to the length-n words
avoiding u, and the class-count generating function is c_u(x) / (x^k + (1 - q x) c_u(x)), c_u the
autocorrelation polynomial of u. For unbordered u this is 1/(1 - q x + x^k); for q = 2 the counts are
partial sums of (k-1)-bonacci numbers (k = 3: F(n+3) - 1).
title: Border-containment theorem for one length-preserving relation
